title: Grateful Dead Live at Dane County Coliseum on 1973-10-25
source: Partial Set 2 Source Info: Master 1/2 track Soundboard Reel @ 15ips (Nagra Reel to Reel) > PCM (14-bit)(Sony L-750ESX-HFB tape); Transfer Info: PCM (Sony SL-10)> Sony PCM-601ESD > Behringer Ultramatch Pro > Tascam DA-3000 (wav 16-bit/44.1k)> Adobe Audition 3.0 > TLH flac16

ai_review.summary: Crystal‑clear soundboard capture of an unusual, medley‑rich show with flawless audio.
ai_review.review: The reviewer praises the recording for its strong clarity and near‑perfect reverb, calling it “everything sounded just about perfect.” The performance is described as unusual but compelling, especially the preserved medley that shines through the pristine sound. Overall, both the music and the technical capture earn high marks.

ai_rating.rationale: A single 5‑star review highlights an exceptional performance and excellent soundboard quality; limited data lowers confidence.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Reviewer notes strong clarity, perfect sounding overall, and well‑balanced reverb – indicating a high‑fidelity board mix.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Unusual show featuring a medley that flows smoothly; the pristine recording lets the nuances of the performance shine.
